topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by introducing the themes of cellular transformation and outlining the learning objectives.

topics.label: Tumor virology and experimental transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the investigation of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays to assess cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification, dosage, and mechanisms of cancer mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the functional definitions, pathway mechanisms, and allele dosage effects that distinguish oncogenes from tumor suppressor genes.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of genomic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how failures in DNA repair pathways, replication fidelity, and mitotic chromosome segregation produce sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-step progression, hereditary predisposition, and tumor dynamics
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how the stepwise accumulation of inherited or acquired mutations accelerates tumor development and shapes tumor evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture with concluding remarks, book recommendations, and a forward reference to the next session.
